title: Normalized strong monoidal extension on total complexes
statement: Let (C,J) be a small site and O a commutative ring sheaf. For the actual global scalar-extension functor F [def-weil-pbc-global-section-scalar-extension], its degreewise functor on integer cochain complexes is strong monoidal for the total tensor product [def-weil-pbc-ringed-extended-cech]. The inverse unit constraint is exactly ringFamilyGlobalExtensionAugmentation applied to the identity of the single A-module complex, where A is the global-section ring. The assertion uses the existing complex and unit maps, without choosing a different augmentation.

source.place: Tags 0996 and 099E, assigned proof step 1, extension from modules to total complexes

proof.text: Use the normalized module-level monoidal structure and the proved preservation of small colimits. Module sheaves are additive symmetric monoidal closed categories with small coproducts, so all graded tensor and associativity colimits exist. The already proved source-library Functor.mapCochainComplexMonoidal lifts the additive monoidal functor using preservation of the discrete coproducts indexing total tensors.

Functor.mapCochainComplex_η identifies the inverse complex unit constraint with the inverse of mapCochainComplexεIso. Expand its two factors: the single-complex comparison followed by the single of the inverse module unit. Substitute the normalization of the module unit. The result is the definition of ringFamilyGlobalExtensionAugmentation on the identity, since the functor maps the identity to the identity.

theorem ringFamilyGlobalExtension_complex_monoidal
    {C : Type u} [SmallCategory C] {J : GrothendieckTopology C}
    (O : Sheaf J CommRingCat.{u}) :
    let R := ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u} RingCat.{u})).obj O)
    let A := CochainComplex.onePointRingSheaf (ringFamilyGlobalRing O)
    let R₀ := ((sheafCompose ⊥ (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u} RingCat.{u})).obj A)
    letI := SheafOfModules.isGrothendieckAbelian R
    letI := SheafOfModules.monoidalCategory O
    letI := SheafOfModules.symmetricCategory O
    letI := Classical.choice (SheafOfModules.tensorClosed O).1
    letI := Classical.choice (SheafOfModules.tensorClosed O).2.1
    letI : Abelian (SheafOfModules.{u} R) := inferInstance
    letI : HasZeroObject (SheafOfModules.{u} R) := inferInstance
    letI : HasColimitsOfSize.{0, 0} (SheafOfModules.{u} R) :=
      hasColimitsOfSizeShrink.{0, 0, u} _
    letI := SheafOfModules.isGrothendieckAbelian R₀
    letI := SheafOfModules.monoidalCategory A
    letI := SheafOfModules.symmetricCategory A
    letI := Classical.choice (SheafOfModules.tensorClosed A).1
    letI := Classical.choice (SheafOfModules.tensorClosed A).2.1
    letI : Abelian (RingSiteModules (ringFamilyGlobalRing O)) := inferInstance
    letI : HasZeroObject (RingSiteModules (ringFamilyGlobalRing O)) := inferInstance
    letI : HasColimitsOfSize.{0, 0} (SheafOfModules.{u} R₀) :=
      hasColimitsOfSizeShrink.{0, 0, u} _
    letI := smallClosedCochainMonoidal (RingSiteModules (ringFamilyGlobalRing O))
    letI := smallClosedCochainMonoidal (ringedSiteModules.{u} R)
    ∃ mon : ((ringFamilyGlobalExtension O).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).Monoidal,
      letI := mon
      Functor.OplaxMonoidal.η
          ((ringFamilyGlobalExtension O).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)) =
        ringFamilyGlobalExtensionAugmentation O (𝟙 (ringComplexSingle
          (ringFamilyGlobalRing O)))
